It validates an exact-target blocker and covers no closed frozen obligation. Shared warm dependencies, incomplete accepted trust/provenance, and absence of a distinct signed verifier make this nonrelease evidence.

status_boundary: A passing recipe self-tests only a truthful blocked validation packet. It cannot accept the proof dependency, close the positive root, establish M0/E0/E1, or satisfy cold hermetic, distinct-runner, AUDIT-Z, THEOREM-Z, release, or master-acceptance gates.
